sentences.text: Shri Vivek Shukla - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Vikram Singh - Advocate for the respondent-CBI.

This is the first application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in connection with crime no.514/2011 registered at Police Station Garha, District Jabalpur for offence punishable under Section 420/120B, 419/120B, 468/120B, 467/120B, 471/120B of IPC and Section 4 of Manyata Prapt Pariksha Adhiniyam.
2. This is a case of bail jump.
Earlier, the applicant was granted bail by the trial Court vide order dated 25.02.2015.

During the trial, the applicant could not mark his presence on 22.04.2024,
consequently, arrest warrant was issued.
The applicant, however appeared before the trial Court on 30.04.2024, since then, he is in jail.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been made accused only on the basis of memorandum of co-accused persons, however, there is no evidence against the applicant.

It is further submitted that non-absence of the applicant on 22.04.2024 before the trial Court was inadvertent and he undertakes to further appear on each and every date as may be fixed in this regard.

It is also submitted that the applicant is permanent resident of District Anuppur M.P.,
there is no likelihood of his absconding or tempering with the prosecution case.
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time.
He is ready to furnish adequate security and to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Court.
On these grounds, prayer is made 2 MCRC-24638-2024 to enlarge the applicant on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent has opposed the applicant.

5. Having regard to the period of absence and other facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it appropriate to release the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
8.
